name: heatmap-calendar
title: Heatmap Calendar
description: A contribution-style grid of days in weekly columns, darker for busier days. Hover or focus a day to read it; the total is the caption.

props.name: values
props.description: One count per day, oldest first. The first value is the first day of the first week.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Called when a day is picked with the mouse or the keyboard.

props.name: unit
props.description: Noun for the caption, such as "commits".

props.name: cell
props.description: Size of a day in pixels.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root element.
